ac.title: Manifest Configuration
ac.given: the app is deployed with manifest.json
ac.then: Manifest includes name: "mp3_to_8D - Focus Audio", short_name: "8D Audio", icons (192x192, 512x512, maskable), theme_color, background_color, categories, display: standalone, start_url: "/index.html?source=pwa"

ac.title: Install Event Capture
ac.then: Event is captured and deferred, canInstall state set to true, in-app install prompt becomes visible

ac.title: Install Prompt UI
ac.then: CTA text: "Install for quick access", includes app icon, dismiss button available, has ARIA role="dialog"

ac.title: Native Install Flow Trigger
ac.then: Deferred event.prompt() invoked, native browser install dialog appears, user choice tracked

ac.title: Install Telemetry
ac.given: install prompt is shown or user makes choice
ac.then: INSTALL_PROMPT_SHOWN, INSTALL_ACCEPTED, INSTALL_DISMISSED events logged with timestamp, userAgent, platform

ac.title: Post-Install Detection
ac.when: the app is launched in standalone mode
ac.then: display-mode: standalone detected, isInstalled = true, install prompt hidden permanently, APP_INSTALLED logged

ac.title: App Shortcuts
ac.then: "Start Focus" shortcut launches with ?mode=focus, "Start Calm" launches with ?mode=calm, auto-selects preset

ac.title: Safari Manual Instructions
ac.then: Show alternative instructions: "To install: tap Share > Add to Home Screen", dismissible, persisted

ac.title: Cross-Browser Verification
ac.then: Chrome Desktop: full flow, Chrome Android: full flow + shortcuts, Firefox: install flow, Edge: full flow, Safari: manual instructions

artifact.reason: Pattern to follow for useInstallPrompt hook structure, state management, and event handling
Pattern for InstallPrompt component styling, ARIA attributes, and dismissal behavior
Pattern for toast/prompt UI with action buttons and persistence
Function to call when ?mode= query param detected for auto-applying Focus/Calm preset
Telemetry module to extend with INSTALL_* event types
Workbox configuration context - manifest.json will complement this for full PWA installability
Generated service worker - install prompt requires active SW to trigger beforeinstallprompt
Test pattern to follow for install-prompt.test.js structure, mocking, and assertions

constraints.constraint: All React implementation in index.html (single-file architecture maintained)
manifest.json at project root for proper serving
Icons in /icons/ directory matching manifest paths
Follow localStorage key naming convention: mp3_8d_*
Console logging prefix: [PWA] for install-related logs
Component styling follows toast/banner patterns from E2/E5/E6.1
ARIA role="dialog" and aria-labelledby on install prompt
Keyboard accessible dismiss and install buttons
Query param parsing: synchronous on load
Safari does not fire beforeinstallprompt - requires manual A2HS instructions

interface.name: useInstallPrompt Hook API
interface.signature: function useInstallPrompt(): { canInstall: boolean, isInstalled: boolean, installPromptDeferred: BeforeInstallPromptEvent | null, showInstallPrompt: () => Promise<"accepted" | "dismissed">, dismissInstallPrompt: () => void }

interface.name: Web App Manifest
interface.signature: { name, short_name, description, start_url, display, orientation, theme_color, background_color, categories, icons[], shortcuts[] }

interface.name: applyPreset
interface.signature: function applyPreset(preset: PresetConfig, presetId: string): void

tests.standards: Unit tests use Node.js with custom assert helpers (no Jest). Test files in tests/ directory with *.test.js naming. Mock localStorage, navigator, and browser APIs. Follow existing test structure from service-worker.test.js (44 tests). Tests run via npm test which chains all test files. Console output with emoji indicators for pass/fail.
